statement.en: This level is set in Ottawa, on the Ottawa River. Discover Canada says Ottawa was chosen as Canada's capital in 1857. The National Capital Region around the city looks after its built heritage and its natural environment. The Rideau Canal was once a military waterway, and today it is a tourist attraction and a winter skateway.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Ottawa, au bord de la rivière des Outaouais. Découvrir le Canada indique qu'Ottawa a été choisie comme capitale du Canada en 1857. La région de la capitale nationale, autour de la ville, veille sur son patrimoine bâti et son milieu naturel. Le canal Rideau était autrefois une voie militaire; c'est aujourd'hui une attraction touristique et une patinoire d'hiver.

source.quote: Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857

verification.evidence: Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857 by Queen Victoria … The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area’s built heritage and natural environment. Picture: (from Top to Bottom) Ottawa’s Rideau Canal, once a military waterway, is now a tourist attraction and winter skateway.

blurb.en: Take a moment at the locks. Discover Canada says the Sovereign is a symbol of Canada's sovereignty, a guardian of the freedoms set out in the Constitution, and a reflection of our history.
blurb.fr: Prenez un moment aux écluses. Découvrir le Canada dit que le souverain ou la souveraine est un symbole de la souveraineté du Canada, un gardien des libertés prévues par la Constitution et un reflet de notre histoire.

source.quote: Her Majesty is a symbol of Canadian sovereignty, a guardian of constitutional freedoms, and a reflection of our history.

verification.evidence: As a constitutional monarchy, Canada's Head of State is a hereditary Sovereign (Queen or King), who reigns in accordance with the Constitution: the rule of law. The Sovereign is a part of Parliament, playing an important, non-partisan role as the focus of citizenship and allegiance, most visibly during royal visits to Canada. Her Majesty is a symbol of Canadian sovereignty, a guardian of constitutional freedoms, and a reflection of our history.

blurb.en: Here is how a bill starts on its way to becoming a law. First it is read and printed. At second reading, members debate the main idea behind the bill. Then a committee studies it clause by clause.
blurb.fr: Voici comment un projet de loi commence son parcours vers l'adoption. Il est d'abord lu et imprimé. À la deuxième lecture, les députés débattent de l'idée principale du projet de loi. Ensuite, un comité l'étudie article par article.

source.quote: First Reading – The bill is considered read for the first STEP 1 time and is printed. STEP 2 Second Reading – Members debate the bill’s principle. Committee Stage – Committee members study the bill STEP 3 clause by clause.

verification.evidence: First Reading – The bill is considered read for the first STEP 1 time and is printed. STEP 2 Second Reading – Members debate the bill’s principle. Committee Stage – Committee members study the bill STEP 3 clause by clause.

blurb.en: A bill that reaches the Senate goes through much the same steps it has already been through. The Senate looks at it again, step by step.
blurb.fr: Un projet de loi qui arrive au Sénat passe par des étapes semblables à celles qu'il a déjà franchies. Le Sénat l'examine de nouveau, étape par étape.

source.quote: Senate – The bill follows a similar process in the Senate.

verification.evidence: Senate – The bill follows a similar process in the Senate.

blurb.en: Snow clearing and places to play sport are jobs for your local government. Municipalities normally look after planning, streets and roads, garbage, snow clearing, firefighting, ambulances, recreation centres, public transit, and some health and social services close to home.
blurb.fr: Le déneigement et les lieux où faire du sport relèvent de votre administration locale. Les municipalités s'occupent normalement de l'aménagement, des rues et des routes, des ordures, du déneigement, de la lutte contre les incendies, des ambulances, des centres de loisirs, du transport en commun et de certains services de santé et services sociaux près de chez vous.

source.quote: Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.

verification.evidence: Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.
